cards.text: Big battle shaping up, friend. The Philistines bring all their forces together at Aphek, while Israel camps by the spring in Jezreel. David, anointed as Israel's next king (1 Samuel 16:13), has been living in Philistine territory under Achish, king of Gath (1 Samuel 27:2-7).

cards.question: The Philistine leaders march out in units of hundreds and thousands. Where in that line are David and his men?

cards.text: The Philistine commanders spot David's crew in the line and ask, “What about these Hebrews?” Friend, that's the look you give when the other team's star player strolls into YOUR locker room the night before the big game.

cards.question: Achish speaks up: this is David, servant of King Saul of Israel. True or false: Achish says he's found no fault in David from the day he defected until today.

cards.text: The commanders are not convinced, not even a little bit. They're ANGRY with Achish.

cards.question: What do the angry Philistine commanders tell Achish to do with David?

answers.text: Send him back where you assigned him
Hand him over to King Saul
Keep him under guard in the camp

cards.question: The commanders say David must not go down into battle with them, only to become their ___ during the war.

cards.text: They figure there's no better way for David to win back his master's favor than with the heads of their men.

cards.question: The commanders back up their worry with a song people sing about David in their dances. What does the song say about David?

answers.text: He has slain even more than Saul
He is Saul's most loyal servant
He is the bravest of the Philistines

cards.text: So Achish calls David in and tells him, “As surely as the LORD lives, you have been upright, and it seems right in my sight that you should march in and out with me in the army…”

cards.question: True or false: Achish tells David that the Philistine leaders see him as good too.

cards.text: So Achish tells David to turn back now and go in peace, so he won't do anything to displease the Philistine leaders.
David pushes back: “But what have I done?” Friend, that's the face of a man who showed up on time, worked hard, and still got sent home before his shift even started.

cards.question: David asks Achish what he's found against him to keep him from going along to fight against the ___ of his lord the king.

cards.text: Achish tells David he's as pleasing in his sight as an angel of God. But the commanders have spoken: he must not go into battle with them.

cards.question: Achish gives David his orders: get up ___ in the morning with the men who came with you, and go as soon as it is ___.
Next morning, David and his men are up early. Where are they headed?

answers.text: Back to the land of the Philistines
Over to Saul's camp at Gilboa

cards.question: True or false: the Philistines go up to Jezreel.

cards.text: And that's where we'll leave it for now, friend. This story is far from finished.
